steps.name: Calibrate & Align Capillary Chamber
steps.description: Align test chamber with rack optical observation axis and lock stabilization ring.

steps.description: Retrieve micro-pipette cartridge and inject dye into primary test channel.

steps.description: Visually observe zero-gravity capillary meniscus advance under UV illumination.

steps.description: Open the recovery valve to purge fluid into waste containment slot.

steps.name: Seal & Stow Fluid Waste Slot
steps.description: Close secondary isolation lock and return fluid cartridge to payload slot.
